dispatch_valid: Seal intact with the right code at dispatch
dispatch_invalid: Dispatch photo did not show an intact seal with the right code
handoff_intact: Seal intact with the right code at handoff
handoff_broken: Seal broken at handoff, before the customer opened the bag
handoff_unusable: Handoff snap did not show the seal code clearly
gate_code_mismatch: Seal code in the claim photo does not match this order
gate_fingers_mismatch: Claim photo does not show the requested number of fingers
gate_time_invalid: Claim photo time is earlier than the challenge
gate_window_expired: Claim photo was taken after the challenge window closed
gate_moire_high: Claim photo looks like a photo of a screen (moiré pattern)
gate_screen_suspected: On-device check suspects a photo of a screen
gate_challenge_low_confidence: Low confidence reading the claim photo
gate_damage_check_missing: No damage check was run on the tapped item
gate_damage_low_confidence: Low confidence assessing the tapped item
claim_items_invalid: Selected items do not match this order
damage_none_on_crop: No damage visible on the tapped item
damage_issue_mismatch: Tapped item shows a different problem than the one reported
damage_item_mismatch: Tapped item looks like a different item from the order
wrong_item_disputed: Tapped item looks like the item that was ordered
refund_capped_at_order_total: Refund capped at the order total
over_auto_approve_cap: Refund is above the instant-refund limit
claim_history_limit: Too many claims in the last 30 days for an instant refund
cloud_review_unavailable: Consistency review could not be completed
counter_evidence_clear: Restaurant counter-evidence shows the parcel sealed with the right code
counter_evidence_unclear: Restaurant counter-evidence was not clear enough
counter_evidence_repeats_dispatch: The dispatch photo already shows this; a second photo can't add to it
